summary: Mergeable PR with minor style issues. The proposed patch correctly resolves the issue without introducing clear correctness, regression, or compatibility problems.

issues.description: The patch introduces a new attribute 'unsafe_chars' which is not documented.
The patch uses a frozenset for 'unsafe_chars' which is not the conventional way to define a set of characters in Django.
The patch does not add any new tests to cover the new behavior.
